source.text:
Are captchas still useful?

If you are using Captchas to protect resources from automated abuse or you have experience with solving captchas using automation, what are your experiences?

Are there still any captchas that humans can solve but AI struggles with or that are at least expensive to solve?

What about accessible captchas for visually impaired users?

Generally the industry seems to move to proof of work and fingerprinting and behavioral analysis. Is anyone successful with running their own traditional captchas for their purpose?

Any insights are appreciated.
source.title: Ask HN: State of the Captcha
